name: Discounts
descr: The discount groups of the store and the rules standing in them. A goods carries a group by store.disc_group_id - the Price tool writes it - and the rules of that group say what the discount is: from_sum is where a rule starts, disc_proc is how much it takes off, and the two days are the ones it lives between. A group holding no rule gives nothing away. A rule writes its currency in sum_curr_id, and the Currencies tool answers those.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the discount groups and nothing beside them. The rules standing in them come with CmdListFull.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the discount groups together with every rule standing in them - two tables in one answer. A group with no rule gives nothing away.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a discount group at the end of the list. It gives nothing away until a rule stands in it.

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the group

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of groups, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the group

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the group

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes discount groups by id. The first call counts the goods priced by them, the second one does it: store.disc_group_id is emptied, so those goods sell without a discount, and the rules of the groups go with them.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the group, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

params.name: relation
params.descr: true - the references pointing at these rows are emptied as well; left out, they stay as they are

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the discount groups in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdRateAdd
commands.descr: Adds a rule to discount groups: one row of disc_rate on each of them. The rules of one group stand by from_sum, so several of them make a ladder; the days are opened the way the program opens them - from now, for ten years.

params.name: group_id
params.descr: id of the discount group, or several of them

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of DISC_KIND_KEY - what the rule counts by; kGoods goes by the sum of the goods

params.name: from_sum
params.descr: where the rule starts - the sum, or the number the kind counts by

params.name: sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency that sum is written in - the Currencies tool answers them

params.name: disc_proc
params.descr: how much the rule takes off, in per cent

params.name: begin_time
params.descr: the day the rule starts living; left out - now

params.name: end_time
params.descr: the day the rule stops; left out - ten years on, the way the program opens one

commands.name: CmdRateUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of rules, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids. A rule does not move to another group: take it back and add it anew.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the rule, or several of them

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of DISC_KIND_KEY - what the rule counts by; kGoods goes by the sum of the goods

params.name: from_sum
params.descr: where the rule starts - the sum, or the number the kind counts by

params.name: sum_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency that sum is written in - the Currencies tool answers them

params.name: disc_proc
params.descr: how much the rule takes off, in per cent

params.name: begin_time
params.descr: the day the rule starts living

params.name: end_time
params.descr: the day the rule stops

commands.name: CmdRateRemove
commands.descr: Deletes rules by id. The group stays, and gives nothing away while it holds no rule.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the rule, or several of them
